caption:
87% of Sri Lankan adults don't exercise. And seeni and pressure are common in our families.

The good news is you don't need a gym. Ten minutes of push-ups, 3 days a week, is a good start. Begin on a wall if you need to.

Tag someone who keeps saying "from Monday".

Sources: WHO STEPS Sri Lanka 2021; Momma et al., BJSM 2022; Alkhayl et al., Sci Rep 2022. These show links, not guarantees. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, talk to your doctor first.
